merged.world: An evaluation assistant checks whether technical equipment and materials meet eligibility thresholds for healthcare procurement, rebate programs, municipal supply, and tax credits.

E1.text: Vortex 500 Ventilator holds an active ISO 13485 certification.

E2.text: Vortex 500 Ventilator holds an active CE mark certification.

E3.text: Vortex 500 Ventilator recorded 0 critical safety incidents in the last year.

policies.B1: Baseline quality compliance is granted to a medical device holding either a valid ISO 13485 credential or an active CE mark credential.
policies.B2: A medical device meeting baseline quality standards achieves tier-one safety status if its annual critical safety incidents do not exceed 0.
policies.D1: Hospital purchasing approval is granted for a device with premier safety standing that maintains liability insurance coverage of at least 5000000 USD.
policies.B3: Rebate eligibility for high efficiency is awarded to a charger with an energy efficiency rating of at least 90 percent.
policies.B4: Municipal water filtration compliance requires a filter to possess a NSF/ANSI Standard 53 credential.
policies.B5: Green building tax credits apply to insulation demonstrating a thermal resistance value of at least 30 R-value.

decoy_policies: Commercial lighting fixtures receive utility tariff discounts when their power factor exceeds 0.95.
Industrial protective helmets receive severe-impact clearance if they pass a drop test threshold of 100 joules.

B1: Holding an active ISO 13485 certification directly satisfies the baseline quality compliance policy.
Holding an active CE mark certification directly satisfies the baseline quality compliance policy.
B2: Meeting baseline quality standards combined with recording 0 critical safety incidents over the last year fulfills tier-one safety criteria.
D1: Achieving tier-one safety classification and maintaining 5000000 USD in liability insurance coverage permits hospital purchasing approval.
B3: An energy efficiency rating of 92 percent satisfies the minimum 90 percent threshold for high-efficiency rebate eligibility.
B4: Possessing a NSF/ANSI Standard 53 certification satisfies the requirements for municipal water filtration compliance.
B5: A thermal resistance value of 30 R-value fulfills the threshold required to receive green building tax credits.
